newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan ministry checking Zambia copper imports data.
newsitem.headline: Japan ministry checking Zambia copper imports data.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry said on Friday it was checking copper import statistics for October which showed a surge in imports from Zambia, after receiving a number of queries about the figures.

The ministry's copper import statistics, released on Thursday, showed that imports of the red metal from Zambia rocketed to 105,222 tonnes in October compared with 7,083 tonnes in September and 3,172 tonnes a year earlier.
This pushed up total copper imports to 130,557 tonnes in October, a rise of 414.63 percent from same month a year earlier.
"We've received some queries about the figures, and are reviewing them," a Finance Ministry official said.
"If we find any miscalculation, the correct figures will be announced as soon as possible," he said, without going into detail on the possible time frame.
Another Finance Ministry official said the ministry is re-checking all documents from customs offices for October, adding that it would take nearly three weeks to review the metal import data.
